lines.text: Many learners say: Is a park in my city.
Better: There is a park in my city.
Use there is to say it exists.
There is! There is a bed in my room.

data.wrong: Is a park in my city.
data.right: There is a park in my city.
data.why: Use there is to say it exists.

native.tip: نقول بالعربية «في مدينتي حديقة» بلا كلمة مثل there، لكن الإنجليزية تحتاجها: “There is a park in my city.” وليس “Is a park in my city”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “Is a park in my city.” 😅 نقول there is للدلالة على الوجود ولا نبدأ بـ is وحدها، فالجملة الصحيحة “There is a park in my city.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “There is”. نقول there is للدلالة على الوجود ولا نبدأ بـ is وحدها. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “Is a park in my city”?
en.tip: To say something exists we start with there is: “There is a park in my city.” not “Is a park in my city”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “Is a park in my city.” 😅 In English we say there is to show that something exists, so the right sentence is “There is a park in my city.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
